description: This file implements classes and functions related to AWS IoT SDK core protocol, including progressive backoff for reconnects, SigV4 signing for AWS requests, and WebSocket handling with custom framing and handshake logic.

classes.name: ProgressiveBackOffCore
classes.description: Handles progressive backoff logic for auto-reconnect attempts.

classes.name: SigV4Core
classes.description: Performs AWS SigV4 signing and credential management for AWS IoT WebSocket connections.

classes.name: SecuredWebSocketCore
classes.description: Manages WebSocket connection, handshake, framing, and data transfer with AWS IoT using SigV4 signing.

methods.name: configTime
methods.description: Configures custom backoff timing parameters.

methods.name: backOff
methods.description: Performs backoff delay and updates backoff time.

methods.name: startStableConnectionTimer
methods.description: Starts timer to reset backoff after stable connection.

methods.name: stopStableConnectionTimer
methods.description: Stops the stable connection timer.

methods.name: _connectionStableThenResetBackoffTime
methods.description: Resets backoff time after stable connection.

methods.name: setIAMCredentials
methods.description: Sets AWS IAM credentials.

methods.name: _createAmazonDate
methods.description: Creates AWS date string for signing.

methods.name: _sign
methods.description: Signs message with HMAC SHA256.

methods.name: _getSignatureKey
methods.description: Generates signing key for SigV4.

methods.name: _checkIAMCredentials
methods.description: Checks and retrieves AWS credentials from environment, config file, or custom.

methods.name: createWebsocketEndpoint
methods.description: Creates AWS SigV4 signed WebSocket URL.

methods.name: _hasCredentialsNecessaryForWebsocket
methods.description: Validates presence of necessary AWS credentials for WebSocket.

methods.name: _handShake
methods.description: Performs WebSocket handshake with AWS IoT endpoint.

methods.name: _encodeFrame
methods.description: Encodes data into WebSocket frame.

methods.name: _closeWssConnection
methods.description: Sends WebSocket close frame.

methods.name: _sendPONG
methods.description: Sends WebSocket PONG frame.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from WebSocket, handling frame parsing and MQTT payload extraction.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Sends data over WebSocket in a frame.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection.

methods.name: getpeercert
methods.description: Returns SSL peer certificate.

methods.name: getSSLSocket
methods.description: Returns underlying SSL socket if connected.
